question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank no. 3.
solution:
The correct answer is '**evidence**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The passage is referring to something that is crucial for solving a crime or proving a point.
 
• The appropriate noun should indicate something that supports or disproves an assertion or hypothesis.
 
• "**Evidence**" fits well as it denotes a source of information that can prove or disprove something, aligning with the context of solving a crime or making a case.
 
• Other options ("**opportunity**", "**time**", "**crime**") do not fit the context of providing crucial support for solving the issue discussed.

Therefore, the correct answer is '**Option 4**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Opportunity (अवसर): "Opportunity" means a set of circumstances that makes it possible to do something, which does not fit the context of discussing the crucial aspect of solving a crime or proving a point.
 
• Time (समय): "Time" refers to the indefinite continued progress of existence and events, which does not align with the idea of supporting or proving something.
 
• Crime (अपराध): "Crime" refers to an action or activity considered illegal, which does not fit the context of providing crucial support for solving the issue discussed.
